steps.name: environment
steps.description: Validate Node >=18 and npm presence, compute npm global bin and embed it safely into /etc/profile.d/node_env_frontend.sh with NODE_ENV=development and a literal absolute npm global bin path. Verify that the npm global bin exists and fall back to /usr/local/bin. Record node and npm versions to /tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt for diagnostics. Create the workspace and ensure it is writable by the current user. File writes use timestamped backups when modifying existing profile.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/weather-app-224060-224298/FrontendApplication"
PROFILE=/etc/profile.d/node_env_frontend.sh
# verify node and npm
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERR_NODE_MISSING" >&2; exit 10; fi
NODE_RAW=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || true)
NODE_VER=$(printf "%s" "$NODE_RAW" | sed -E 's/^v//' | sed -E 's/[^0-9\.].*$//')
MAJOR=${NODE_VER%%.*}
if ! [[ $MAJOR =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] || [ "$MAJOR" -lt 18 ]; then echo "ERR_NODE_VERSION: Node >=18 required, found '$NODE_RAW'" >&2; exit 11; fi
if ! command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "ERR_NPM_MISSING" >&2; exit 12; fi
NPM_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
# verify npm global bin exists and is a directory
if [ -z "$NPM_BIN" ] || [ ! -d "$NPM_BIN" ]; then NPM_BIN="/usr/local/bin"; echo "WARN_NPM_BIN_FALLBACK" >&2; fi
# record versions for diagnostics
printf "%s\n" "node=$NODE_RAW" "npm=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo unknown)" > /tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt
# write profile atomically with literal $PATH preserved (escape $)
TMP=$(mktemp)
cat > "$TMP" <<EOF
# FrontendApplication environment (generated)
export NODE_ENV=development
# ensure npm global bin on PATH
export PATH="$NPM_BIN:\$PATH"
EOF
# backup existing profile if different
if sudo test -f "$PROFILE"; then sudo cmp -s "$TMP" "$PROFILE" || sudo cp -a "$PROFILE" "$PROFILE".$(date +%s).bak; fi
sudo install -m 0644 "$TMP" "$PROFILE" && sudo chown root:root "$PROFILE"
rm -f "$TMP"
# ensure workspace exists and is writable
mkdir -p "$WS"
chown -R $(id -u):$(id -g) "$WS" || true
# verify visibility: print recorded versions
cat /tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt

steps.name: scaffold react app
steps.description: If the workspace is strictly empty (no files except optional .git directory), scaffold a non-interactive React app. Detection uses a safe find command to avoid false positives. Scaffolding occurs in a temporary directory and is moved into place on success to avoid accidental deletion of existing workspace content. Prefer container-provided create-react-app; fallback to npx create-react-app@latest, then to npm init vite if needed. Support TypeScript selection via USE_TYPESCRIPT=1 environment variable or recursive search for .ts files when the workspace is not empty.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/weather-app-224060-224298/FrontendApplication"
cd "$WS"
# allow scaffold only when directory is empty except optional .git
if find "$WS" -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -not -name '.git' -print -quit | read; then echo "SKIP_SCAFFOLD_NON_EMPTY"; exit 0; fi
# detect TS preference: env override or existing repo files (rare for empty)
USE_TS=0
if [ "${USE_TYPESCRIPT:-0}" = "1" ]; then USE_TS=1; elif find "$WS" -type f -name '*.ts' -print -quit | read; then USE_TS=1; fi
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
# prefer global create-react-app
if command -v create-react-app >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if [ "$USE_TS" -eq 1 ]; then create-react-app "$TMPDIR" --template typescript --use-npm --yes --silent --no-analytics; else create-react-app "$TMPDIR" --use-npm --yes --silent --no-analytics; fi
fi
# fallback to npx create-react-app@latest
if [ ! -f "$TMPDIR/package.json" ]; then
  if command -v npx >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ "$USE_TS" -eq 1 ]; then npx create-react-app@latest "$TMPDIR" --template typescript --use-npm --yes --silent --no-analytics; else npx create-react-app@latest "$TMPDIR" --use-npm --yes --silent --no-analytics; fi
  fi
fi
# final fallback to Vite
if [ ! -f "$TMPDIR/package.json" ]; then
  if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if [ "$USE_TS" -eq 1 ]; then npm init vite@latest "$TMPDIR" -- --template react-ts --yes --silent; else npm init vite@latest "$TMPDIR" -- --template react --yes --silent; fi
    (cd "$TMPDIR" && npm i --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error) || true
  fi
fi
# verify package.json then move into place atomically
if [ ! -f "$TMPDIR/package.json" ]; then rm -rf "$TMPDIR" || true; echo "ERR_SCAFFOLD_FAILED" >&2; exit 20; fi
# create minimal .env inside TMPDIR
cat > "$TMPDIR/.env" <<EOF
REACT_APP_API_URL=http://localhost:8000
EOF
# move contents into workspace
shopt -s dotglob
mv "$TMPDIR"/* "$WS"/ || true
rm -rf "$TMPDIR"

steps.name: install dependencies
steps.description: Install project dependencies non-interactively. Prefer npm ci when package-lock.json present, otherwise npm install. Add missing essential dependencies (react, react-dom, react-scripts) only if absent in package.json; do not overwrite existing constraints. Prefer global container-provided 'serve' and 'create-react-app' binaries; only install local serve persistently (saved in package.json) if global serve is not available. After install, validate installed package versions for react/react-dom/react-scripts and record results for diagnostics.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/weather-app-224060-224298/FrontendApplication"
cd "$WS"
# ensure package.json exists
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  cat > package.json <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "frontendapp",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true
}
EOF
fi
# add missing essential deps only if absent
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.dependencies=p.dependencies||{};if(!p.dependencies.react)p.dependencies.react='^18.2.0';if(!p.dependencies['react-dom'])p.dependencies['react-dom']='^18.2.0';if(!p.dependencies['react-scripts'] && !p.devDependencies?.vite)p.dependencies['react-scripts']='^5.0.1';p.scripts=p.scripts||{};p.scripts.build=p.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';p.scripts.start=p.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';p.scripts.test=p.scripts.test||'react-scripts test --watchAll=false';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));" >/dev/null
# network probe using npm ping when available
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! npm ping >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "WARN_NETWORK_NPM" >&2; fi
fi
# install
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error || { echo "ERR_NPM_CI" >&2; exit 30; }
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error || { echo "ERR_NPM_INSTALL" >&2; exit 31; }
fi
# prefer global serve from image; if absent, persistently add serve to package.json and install
if command -v serve >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "USING_GLOBAL_SERVE" >/tmp/frontend_serve_choice.txt; else
  # ensure serve in package.json devDependencies
  node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.devDependencies=p.devDependencies||{};if(!p.devDependencies.serve)p.devDependencies.serve='^14.1.1';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));" >/dev/null
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error || true
  echo "USING_LOCAL_SERVE" >/tmp/frontend_serve_choice.txt
fi
# post-install validation: record installed versions
RS_VER=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('missing')}" 2>/dev/null || true)
RDOM_VER=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/react-dom/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('missing')}" 2>/dev/null || true)
RSCRIPTS_VER=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/react-scripts/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('missing')}" 2>/dev/null || true)
printf "%s\n" "react=$RS_VER" "react-dom=$RDOM_VER" "react-scripts=$RSCRIPTS_VER" > /tmp/frontend_pkg_versions.txt
# basic compatibility checks
if [[ "$RS_VER" = missing || "$RDOM_VER" = missing ]]; then echo "ERR_MISSING_REACT" >&2; exit 32; fi
if ! [[ "$RS_VER" =~ ^18\. ]]; then echo "WARN_REACT_VERSION_MISMATCH: $RS_VER" >&2; fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

# workspace from container info
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/weather-app-224060-224298/FrontendApplication"
mkdir -p "$WS" && cd "$WS"
# record env versions for diagnostics
{ command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 && node -v || echo "node_missing"; command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm -v || echo "npm_missing"; } > /tmp/frontend_env_versions.txt
# ensure package.json exists (safe minimal)
if [ ! -f package.json ]; then
  cat > package.json <<'EOF'
{
  "name": "frontendapp",
  "version": "0.1.0",
  "private": true
}
EOF
fi

# Add missing essential deps only if absent, preserve existing constraints. Do not change devDependencies Vite if present.
node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.dependencies=p.dependencies||{};if(!('react' in p.dependencies))p.dependencies.react='^18.2.0';if(!('react-dom' in p.dependencies))p.dependencies['react-dom']='^18.2.0';if(!('react-scripts' in p.dependencies) && !(p.devDependencies && ('vite' in p.devDependencies)))p.dependencies['react-scripts']='^5.0.1';p.scripts=p.scripts||{};p.scripts.build=p.scripts.build||'react-scripts build';p.scripts.start=p.scripts.start||'react-scripts start';p.scripts.test=p.scripts.test||'react-scripts test --watchAll=false';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));" >/dev/null

# Prefer global create-react-app / serve if present (preinstalled in image). Determine global npm bin path and persist environment for shells.
NGLOBAL_BIN=$(npm bin -g 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -z "${NGLOBAL_BIN:-}" ] || [ ! -d "$NGLOBAL_BIN" ]; then NGLOBAL_BIN="/usr/local/bin"; fi
PROFILE_FILE=/etc/profile.d/node_env_frontend.sh
TS=$(date +%s)
if [ -w /etc/profile.d ] 2>/dev/null; then
  if [ -f "$PROFILE_FILE" ]; then sudo cp "$PROFILE_FILE" "${PROFILE_FILE}.bak.$TS"; fi
  sudo bash -c "cat > $PROFILE_FILE <<'EOF'
export NODE_ENV=development
export PATH=$NGLOBAL_BIN:\$PATH
EOF
"
fi

# Quick network probe for npm
if command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  if ! npm ping >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "WARN_NETWORK_NPM" >&2; fi
fi

# Install: prefer npm ci when package-lock.json present
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  npm ci --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error || { echo "ERR_NPM_CI" >&2; exit 30; }
else
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error || { echo "ERR_NPM_INSTALL" >&2; exit 31; }
fi

# Prefer global serve binary; if absent, add serve to package.json devDependencies and persistently install locally
if command -v serve >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "USING_GLOBAL_SERVE" >/tmp/frontend_serve_choice.txt
else
  # add serve to package.json devDependencies only if absent
  node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json'));p.devDependencies=p.devDependencies||{};if(!('serve' in p.devDependencies))p.devDependencies.serve='^14.1.1';fs.writeFileSync('package.json',JSON.stringify(p,null,2));" >/dev/null
  # install updated package.json deps persistently
  npm i --no-audit --no-fund --loglevel=error || true
  echo "USING_LOCAL_SERVE" >/tmp/frontend_serve_choice.txt
fi

# Post-install validation: capture installed package versions (or 'missing') and write to /tmp/frontend_pkg_versions.txt
RS_VER=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/react/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('missing')}" 2>/dev/null || true)
RDOM_VER=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/react-dom/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('missing')}" 2>/dev/null || true)
RSCRIPTS_VER=$(node -e "try{console.log(require('./node_modules/react-scripts/package.json').version)}catch(e){console.log('missing')}" 2>/dev/null || true)
printf "%s\n" "react=$RS_VER" "react-dom=$RDOM_VER" "react-scripts=$RSCRIPTS_VER" > /tmp/frontend_pkg_versions.txt

# Basic compatibility checks and exit codes
if [ "${RS_VER:-missing}" = "missing" ] || [ "${RDOM_VER:-missing}" = "missing" ]; then
  echo "ERR_MISSING_REACT" >&2
  exit 32
fi
# warn if react major not 18
case "$RS_VER" in
  18.*) ;;
  *) echo "WARN_REACT_VERSION_MISMATCH: $RS_VER" >&2 ;;
esac

# Ensure the diagnostics files reflect chosen choices
command -v npm >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm --version > /tmp/frontend_npm_version.txt || true
node -v > /tmp/frontend_node_version.txt 2>/dev/null || true

exit 0

steps.name: build and validate app (build -> serve -> stop)
steps.description: Build the app (npm run build), serve built files headlessly on PORT 5000 using container-global serve if present or project-local serve otherwise. Start serve in foreground, capture its PID, install a trap to ensure cleanup on any exit, validate the server by performing HTTP health checks with retries, record evidence, then cleanly stop the process after validation. Ensure PID is numeric before attempting to kill and fallback defensively if ss/lsof are unavailable.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/weather-app-224060-224298/FrontendApplication"
cd "$WS"
PORT=5000
LOG=/tmp/frontend_serve.log
# build
npm run build --silent || { echo 'ERR_BUILD_FAILED' >&2; exit 50; }
# choose serve: prefer global then project-local
if command -v serve >/dev/null 2>&1; then SERVE_BIN=$(command -v serve); SERVE_ARGS=("-s" "build" "-l" "$PORT");
elif [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/serve ]; then SERVE_BIN="./node_modules/.bin/serve"; SERVE_ARGS=("-s" "build" "-l" "$PORT");
else echo 'ERR_SERVE_MISSING' >&2; exit 51; fi
# start serve in foreground and capture PID; ensure log capture
: >"$LOG"
"$SERVE_BIN" "${SERVE_ARGS[@]}" >"$LOG" 2>&1 &
SERVE_PID=$!
# ensure cleanup on exit
_cleanup() {
  if [ -n "${SERVE_PID:-}" ] && [[ "$SERVE_PID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
    kill "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap _cleanup EXIT INT TERM
# wait for port; prefer ss or lsof if available to confirm listener, else rely on PID
LISTEN_PID=""
for i in 0 1 2 3 4 5; do
  if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    LISTEN_PID=$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk -v p=":$PORT" '$4~p{match($0,/pid=([0-9]+)/,a); if(a[1])print a[1]; exit}') || true
  elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    LISTEN_PID=$(lsof -iTCP:$PORT -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
  if [ -n "$LISTEN_PID" ]; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
# fallback to serve starter PID if no listener detected
if [ -z "$LISTEN_PID" ]; then LISTEN_PID="$SERVE_PID"; fi
# simple HTTP health check with retries
HTTP=000
MAX=12
i=0
while [ $i -lt $MAX ]; do
  sleep $((i<3?1:2))
  HTTP=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" http://localhost:${PORT}/ || true)
  if [[ "$HTTP" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ || "$HTTP" = "000" ]]; then break; fi
  i=$((i+1))
done
if ! [[ "$HTTP" =~ ^2[0-9][0-9]$ ]]; then echo "ERR_VALIDATION_HTTP: $HTTP; see $LOG" >&2; exit 52; fi
# evidence
printf "%s\n" "pid=$LISTEN_PID" "http=$HTTP" "log=$LOG" > /tmp/frontend_validation_result.txt
# cleanup (trap will run)
_cleanup
trap - EXIT

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Defensive stop: read PID file, verify numeric, attempt graceful kill, fallback if ss/lsof unavailable
PIDFILE=/tmp/frontend_serve.pid
if [ ! -f "$PIDFILE" ]; then echo "ERR_NO_PIDFILE" >&2; exit 60; fi
SERVE_PID=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
if ! [[ "$SERVE_PID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then echo "ERR_PID_NOT_NUMERIC: $SERVE_PID" >&2; # attempt to find process listening on 5000
  if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    SERVE_PID=$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | awk -v p=":5000" '$4~p{match($0,/pid=([0-9]+)/,a); if(a[1])print a[1]; exit}') || true
  elif command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    SERVE_PID=$(lsof -iTCP:5000 -sTCP:LISTEN -t 2>/dev/null || true)
  fi
fi
if [ -z "${SERVE_PID:-}" ]; then echo "ERR_NO_PID_DETECTED" >&2; exit 61; fi
# attempt graceful stop
kill "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
if ps -p "$SERVE_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  kill -9 "$SERVE_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
fi
rm -f "$PIDFILE"
